raw_comment:
My first thought seeing the graph was that the entire country is enveloped in varying degrees of drought and there are hardly any areas unaffected by it.
I wonder how much of an affect climate changes over recent times have had an impact and how much does this effect the nation as a whole.
This relates to my community as the map shows the whole of Long Island is affected by a drought, it is noticeable enough that I have seen some lakes in parks starting to dry up.
A headline for this could be "Drought nation: Where the droughts are in the USA"
